Additional static CG extracted from NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Vol.2
(ウチのペット事情 Vol.2).

This gallery is intended to supplement the CG that was not included
in my previous uploads.

Three of the HCG scenes are rendered dynamically by the game engine
and contain a very large number of animation and expression variants.
Uploading every possible frame would be impractical, so only selected
frames, including the beginning and ending frames of each animated
scene, are included here.

One of the CGs is included in an uncensored version. This is not an
AI-generated or manually edited decensor. The uncensored image was
found directly in the extracted game assets. As far as I could find,
this is the only CG in the game that includes an uncensored version.

The original animated CGs are rendered at 4K resolution. Their
uncompressed size would be too large for a practical E-Hentai upload,
so this gallery contains static frames only.
